description: Defines the MtpDatabase interface for managing Media Transfer Protocol (MTP) objects, properties, and sessions within the Android framework.

classes.name: MtpDatabase
classes.description: Abstract interface for MTP database operations, including object management, property access, and session control.

methods.name: beginSendObject
methods.description: Reserves a database entry for an incoming file to be sent.

methods.name: endSendObject
methods.description: Reports success or failure of the file transfer.

methods.name: getObjectList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of objects in a specified storage and parent directory.

methods.name: getNumObjects
methods.description: Returns the number of objects in a specified storage and parent directory.

methods.name: getSupportedPlaybackFormats
methods.description: Returns supported playback formats.

methods.name: getSupportedCaptureFormats
methods.description: Returns supported capture formats.

methods.name: getSupportedObjectProperties
methods.description: Returns supported object properties for a given format.

methods.name: getSupportedDeviceProperties
methods.description: Returns supported device properties.

methods.name: getObjectPropertyValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific object property.

methods.name: setObjectPropertyValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a specific object property.

methods.name: getDevicePropertyValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a device property.

methods.name: setDevicePropertyValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a device property.

methods.name: resetDeviceProperty
methods.description: Resets a device property to its default value.

methods.name: getObjectPropertyList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of object properties.

methods.name: getObjectInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific object.

methods.name: getThumbnail
methods.description: Retrieves the thumbnail for an object.

methods.name: getObjectFilePath
methods.description: Gets the file path, length, and format of an object.

methods.name: deleteFile
methods.description: Deletes an object file.

methods.name: getObjectReferences
methods.description: Retrieves references associated with an object.

methods.name: setObjectReferences
methods.description: Sets references for an object.

methods.name: getObjectPropertyDesc
methods.description: Gets the description of an object property.

methods.name: getDevicePropertyDesc
methods.description: Gets the description of a device property.

methods.name: sessionStarted
methods.description: Marks the start of an MTP session.

methods.name: sessionEnded
methods.description: Marks the end of an MTP session.
